title: OpenAI — Community Communications Lead, CV ready
summary: MIN-208 REWORK: Fixed PNG byte-for-byte reproducibility failure in clean environments. Pinned exact render dependencies in requirements.txt (pypdf==6.21.2, PyMuPDF==2.0, reportlab==5.1.0, Pillow==12.3.0) and pyproject.toml to eliminate zlib/PNG encoder drift caused by permissive '>=' ranges. Verified zero-drift deterministic rebuilds matching committed hashes for both PDF (bd358b1360fb03bc43b79af9c06b24d6ef39bd47368e75ab4455af3eeb8c9026) and 300 DPI HD PNG (0b8c5b49860ff4a076e0dc26486a2abe100e27629b2674456880bb7900ec0e8b). Recomputed SHA-256 manifest and updated verification documentation.
limitations: Pavel is an operator-storyteller rather than a traditional corporate agency PR specialist; positioning leans into builder perspective, publishing, and cross-cultural community narrative.
